name: mcpkeel
description: Checks this project's MCP servers against mcp.lock when a session starts, and blocks calls to a server that changed.

interface.shortDescription: The lockfile for MCP: block servers that changed
interface.longDescription: When a session starts, mcpkeel checks the project's MCP servers against the mcp.lock committed in the repository. A server whose tool descriptions, schemas or package release changed since it was reviewed is reported, and calls to its tools are blocked until the change is reviewed and accepted.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this project's MCP servers still match mcp.lock.
Show what changed in the MCP servers since mcp.lock.
